issues.summary: Stage CLI contained an invalid backslash string literal and failed compileall before Windows-path parsing.
CI pytest collection could not import reusable scripts.* helpers because pytest only added src/ to its import path.
issues.regression_test: pyproject pytest pythonpath includes both src and repository root; full pytest collection imports repository automation helpers.

issues.summary: Bundled layered_sample PNG files were structurally invalid and failed full Pillow decode.
issues.regression_test: Data Check decodes every referenced stage image; release E2E loads layered_sample through the real Data pipeline.

issues.summary: READY and GAME OVER overlay text was centered on the screen and overlapped the lowest rows of standard blocks.
issues.regression_test: appearance.overlay_center_y_ratio is externalized/validated; formal 9-state UI review pack must be visually reviewed.

issues.summary: A Windows packaged executable could start without Pillow bundled and fail immediately with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL'.
issues.regression_test: Build Check and Prebuilt Windows use explicit PyInstaller --collect-all PIL and execute packaged image-stage/release acceptance before accepting the artifact.
